notes.title: Beef Cat Ultra 2.0 Anniversary Update
notes.notes:
Happy 1-Year Anniversary to Beef Cat Ultra!


Beef Cat Ultra released last year on September 23rd 2024. And it has been an excellent year. Out of the gate Beef Cat Ultra reached a smaller audience than we anticipated - such is game development. But we did a handful of polish patches and released the large Remix update for Steam users adding endless endgame content for diehard players.

In late December I cold-emailed an indie game publisher and said "hey I think you should publish my game for consoles" but in a slightly more professional way. And when I woke up the next morning I was surprised to see a return email from them saying "we agree, let's talk" exactly as casually as that. A few short months later, Beef Cat Ultra released for the Nintendo Switch consoles, Playstation 4/5, and Xbox One and Series consoles.

In the months since, we've been quiet on Beef Cat Ultra while we worked on other projects and tried some new things out. But I've been logging every bit of feedback for the game across all platforms and finished a gargantuan Anniversary Patch late last week. This was a holistic look at every thing in the game. Stage design, assets, code - anything that could be looked at was looked at. And a LOT was tweaked.

Let's get into some monster patch notes:
Beef Cat Ultra v2.0 Patch NotesEarly Game Balancing and Onboarding
Beef Cat Survives: Removed a chest from near the starting point, replaced some trees with grassy fenced areas.

Gauntlet Legacy: Moved the first gate closer to the start of the stage so that is shares a screen with the first key, moved a couple early stage enemy spawners, added a bridge over the large body of water to give players another path in a congested space.

Collectathon: Added extra gemmies to the stage, only requires about 90% of gems for stage clear.

Funky Lake Stages: visual improvements to create more landmark type spaces in the environment to help with understanding the layout better.

Broken Forest: changed player starting location, added gemmies, only requires about 90% of gems for stage clear, added an additional path to prevent players getting trapped in the late stage congestion.
General Balancing
Beef Cat base HP 10 -> 12

iFrames 10 -> 12

Froggie base HP 15 -> 18

Badish HP 10 -> 7

Fox HP 6 -> 4

Artibloke HP 20 -> 14

Big Boss Badish HP 500 -> 400

Friend Monster HP 650 -> 450

Added new pickups to all 3 main Metal Mountain stages

All shops base cost adjusted and cost curve reduced
Visual Changes
A new title screen!

World Map has less tile bloat which makes the room instance less of a load on the engine

Tile tweaks to every single stage to increase visual variety

World region text pop up text smaller and color change, added drop shadow, to improve legibility
Quality of Life Changes
Added a kill counter to Survive stages that had Steam Achievements tied to a specific kill count

Pressing Tab (Select on a controller) while in a stage opens audio settings

Trap signs now spawn world appropriate enemies



Itemizing out the little changes to every single stage would make this a sprawling changelog that I do not want to type. So, please enjoy that being reduced to "tweaks to every single stage" for my sanity.



As long as new players are finding Beef Cat Ultra, I'll keep tweaking and improving it. Even as we prepare to launch the Steam page for our next project (the page is currently under review and I was hoping it would be live in time for this update but oh well). If you've played the game, leave a review - it helps us! If you enjoyed it, share it with a friend. Help us make more games by supporting us! We appreciate everyone a ton - whether you hopped in totally in the dark or are a good friend who picked up a copy.



Thank you,

Kyle

notes.title: v1.1 The Remix Update
notes.notes:
The Remix Update Has Landed

Howdy Beeflandians,

This is a major update that touches every corner of Beef Cat Ultra, adding loads of new content and improving the content that was already there. The Remix Update will kick off a series of much smaller follow-up updates adding new upgrades and items over time to keep the RNG gods of Remix Island pleased. Let's kick off with the main event:

Added Remix Island

 Added Dock and Ship to Stinky Coast
 Added Blockerboy to Stinky Coast to lock Remix Island until Game Completion
 Added 4 new stages with new mode "Remix"
 --Randomized starting location, pickup locations, and enemy spawn locations
 --Objective to Kill 5,000 enemies
 --Difficulty Tier increases every 5 minutes, increasing enemy health and speed
 Added 7 new level up options in Remix mode
 --4 New Weapon Level Up Options
 --2 New Survival Level Up Options
 --1 New Bonus Level Up Options
 Added 4 new pickups in Remix mode loot pools
 New Shop: Great Reset - Resets all stat purchases at shops to ZERO and does not refund their costs
 New Shop: Remix Difficulty - Increases the base Difficulty Tier of Remix Mode by 1
 New Weapon: Uppercut - a vertical attack that deals high damage, upgrades increase range
 New Weapon: Gross Grass - builds in the environment, has a %chance to spawn a tick, upgrades increase tick spawn chance
 New Weapon: Bomb Flower - builds in the environment, trigger to set off an explosion, upgrades reduce planting cooldown
 New Passive: Parry Pants - a successful dodge drops a grenade at your feet, upgrades drop more grenades


Above is very nearly everything new in Beef Cat Ultra as of today. No bug fixes or tweaks in that section, just new things to challenge yourself on. But that doesn't mean we didn't get around to some great tweaks and fixes.

Game-Wide Changes

 Optimized Enemy, Object, and Pickup Parent codes - reducing code by 1000+ lines, should improve engine load in late-late endless stages
 Bullet based weapons now factor in Damage Modification
 Bullet based weapons now factor in Critical Hit Chance
 Replaced the font in Shop menus
 Added a description tip to every shop
 Shop menus no longer display on top of settings menu
 Shops can no longer be interacted with while settings menu is open
 Re-located player spawn location in "High Seas"
 Volleyball pickups now correctly draw a line to Choice Signs
 Added subtle controller rumble to enemy kills
 Difficulty Tier +1 now gives enemies a single extra HP in Endless stages (at the 10 minute mark)
 Added Difficulty Tiers +6-8 to Endless Stages for particularly long games and broken builds
 Added new Stat to Stats Screen: Explosion Mod, increase in value increases radius of explosions
 New Passive Pickup: Cookbook - increases Explosion Mod by 5
 Added Cookbook to World 3/4 Loot Pools and Encyclopedia
 Reduced Corpse Bomb explosion radius from 20 -> 16
 -Reduced Corpse Bomb frag count from 12 -> 10
 -Corpse Bomb, Boom Sticks, and Grenades are all affected by Explosion Mod stat


Beyond some quality-of-life and optimization, an entire new stat was added to the game: Explosion Mod. Alongside this is a new Passive pickup that is available in the base game to increase your Explosion Mod. Shop menus are looking much cleaner and helpful, too. Beyond that was a re-configuring of Endless (and Remix) mode difficulty. Previously the difficulty curve was an amorphous thing with five tiers, it's now a much more defined 8 tier system, allowing the difficulty to get to punishing new heights. Controller players can enjoy the addition of a slight rumble as well, a small taste brought over from our burgeoning console ports.

Enjoy the Remix Update! This is not the end of Beef Cat Ultra, just another step, and we hope you follow along as the game continues to grow!

Thanks,
Kyle

notes.title: The Remix Update: Final Preview
notes.notes:
Howdy Beeflandians!

We are just days away from our largest ever update, adding new stages/mode/weapons, and including tons of little tweaks. To learn more about the basics of the Remix Update, check the previous post.

I wanted to show off some of the new things you can find on Remix Island today! Let's dive in with a look at the Remix Island docks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934816/ec61eb0af80a4d2cf12f01dc35b0426a15052a1d.png

The Remix Island docks have a key quality of life feature: every stat upgrade shop in one convenient location! There are two NEW shops being added as well for thrill seekers. The first is the Great Reset shop. This resets every single stat shop to their default zero values. Did you buy so many damage upgrades you made the game trivial? Reset! OR! Buy in to the Remix Difficulty shop. This increases the base difficulty of the Remix Island stages, with three tiers at patch launch. This difficulty increase is steep and for folks that want a challenge and want to still endlessly buy stat increments. Difficulty too hard? The Great Reset shop will reset this one as well.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934816/86b2b33c87159ae99ff0d053527210cd51b40296.png

Shop menues got a glow-up! Alongside a font change for legibility, every shop now has a brief one line description about what is actually happening when you purchase something. This is applied to shops game-wide, not just Remix Island of course.

Back to Remix Island exclusives, let's take a look at two new weapons.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934816/7363caced962e9fc06148ac779036c68536e94ce.png

Uppercut is a vertical attack that passes through all enemies in it's range. It shares a damage stat with Fisticuffs, meaning upgrading one - upgrades both. Picking up multiple Uppercuts increases the range of the attack. A new level up option on Remix Island increases the damage of fist based attacks as well. Start with Tweezer and hope for some good RNG!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934816/b7b022c974db4e0a85a0ca60d61bded2cc7e60ec.png

Gross Grass is a buildable weapon, placing down weeds every so often. Those weeds have a small chance every now and then to spawn friendly ticks. That spawn chance is shared with the chance that Pills have to spawn Ticks. And a new level up option in Remix Island increases the chance for both weapons to spawn ticks. Disco Debbie is looking good for this weapon.

If you caught a trend with the two new weapons shown here, there's a big emphasis on ~SYNERGIES~. Almost every new weapon, passive, or level up option can have a ripple effect on other weapons, passives, or level up options. With the randomness of Remix Island, building towards a cohesive and destructive build is inherently harder, but with a new focus on synergies your loadout can be given a whole new level of thought.

The Remix Update releases THIS WEEK (After Christmas). I'm stuffing every idea I can into the new upgrade options and then it'll be golden.

See you on Remix Island very soon,
Kyle

notes.title: The Remix Update First Look
notes.notes:
Howdy Beeflandians,

I figured now would be a good time to show off some of the new content in The Remix Update. Beyond tons of little fixes and optimizations, this update has a significant infusion of ~CONTENT~. So let's dive in.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934816/0d51256b9429dcfa2aa5180f329f316e772f7227.png

The Remix Update brings Beef Cat and Friends to Remix Island, a small island south of Stinky Coast. How do you get there? The dock in Stinky Coast of course, which will feature a new boat after beating the final boss. This is post-game content for Beeflandia's Best. Remix Island is home to four new large stages all with the new Remix Mode which for description purposes is our randomizer mode.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934816/3ed07a71344c812ee0125049c3b79adb7067cc8c.png

Navigating the new stages and mode come with a new objective - total enemy kills. Remix tasks you with defeating 5,000 enemy units before you are overwhelmed. Remix features a difficulty curve similar to Endless mode - where after periods of time, enemies have more HP and base speed. That curve is ~harder~ in Remix. Fortune favors the bold. Luckily you have access to a random pool of every piece of loot in the game, including some new items. But the loot isn't the only randomized element for you to grow.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934816/814d08a55c87ee9c30665c0a629e83a822767ee5.png

Regardless of what character you start with, level up screens can contain the bonuses from any of the other characters, and even several completely new level up bonuses exclusive to Remix mode.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934816/bdb5e6971af9a8a36b6c11f04519c2e27a98f813.png

Fight through familiar locations, with random loot, random enemy spawns, random starting point, nearly random everything. Score victories in these stages to endlessly rack up the Remix Island clear counter - unlocking access to new shops and fun things.

---

The goal of this update is to provide endlessly repeatable content for people wanting to just sink in to some Beef Cat Ultra and find something new to challenge them. The update, content and fixes, is well under construction and will release before the end of the year! We hope you will all enjoy a fresh new take on BCU!

Thanks all,
Kyle
